value.name: Asha waits for the registry page to load
value.description: Asha sits in the kitchen waiting for the search page to finish loading while the room stays quiet around her.
evidence: the kitchen held the small mechanical sounds of the refrigerator and her own breathing while the page took its time deciding what to show her
The page took a beat longer than it should have

value.name: Asha listens for movement upstairs
value.description: Asha pauses to listen for any sign of movement from above, but hears nothing except the refrigerator and Claire breathing.
evidence: Asha used the pause to tip her chin toward the ceiling, counting through the quiet for the sound of a mattress shifting or a small foot on the runner above the stairs
Nothing came down through the floorboards but the refrigerator's cycle and Claire's measured breathing across the table

value.name: Rosa sends diversion advice
value.description: Asha receives a text from Rosa advising her to try the emergency mental health diversion list if the registry is blank.
evidence: The phone buzzed against her palm before the portal finished loading: Rosa, one line, telling her that if the registry came back blank she should try the emergency mental health diversion list, which often bypassed the formal logs during an acute pickup

value.name: Asha leaves Rosa unread
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's message but does not reply, instead placing the phone where Claire can see it.
evidence: Asha read it and did not answer, only set the phone flat on the table beside her elbow where Claire could see the screen if she chose to look

value.name: Claire notices the diversion message
value.description: Claire briefly looks at the phone screen and notices the word diversion before returning her attention to her hands.
evidence: and Claire did look, briefly, at the word diversion before her eyes went back to her hands

value.name: Registry search returns no match
value.description: The registry search finishes and shows no matching records, confirming the blank result Asha had been hoping to avoid.
evidence: The registry page finished loading into a clean white field with no matching records
Asha read the blankness twice before she let herself believe it meant what Rosa had said it would mean

value.name: Asha opens diversion list search
value.description: Asha opens a new tab and begins searching the county's emergency mental health diversion list.
evidence: She opened a second tab without closing the first, typed in the search string for the county's emergency mental health diversion list, and was halfway through the form when the phone
